topics.title: Admission Process
topics.response:
Admissions at Galgotias University generally begin with online registration through the official admission portal. Select the programme, complete the personal and academic details, upload the documents requested for that programme, review the application, and submit it. Further steps depend on the programme and may include an applicable entrance examination, merit evaluation, document verification, and fee payment.

For current deadlines, programme-specific requirements, and the applicable entrance route, use the official university admission information because these details can change.

topics.title: Academic Programs and Specializations
topics.response:
Galgotias University offers programmes across multiple academic areas and levels, including engineering and technology, computer applications, management, law, science, design, agriculture, hospitality, media, pharmacy, and other disciplines. Options include undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, certificate, and PhD-level study.

Computer-focused options include B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, BCA, MCA, and related specializations. B.Tech CSE specializations listed in the available university information include Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Data Science, Cyber Security, and Internet of Things. The current programme listing should be checked for the exact course, duration, intake, and entry requirements.

topics.title: Eligibility Criteria
topics.response:
Eligibility is programme-specific. Applicants should check the selected programme's required educational qualification, subjects, minimum marks, and any entrance examination or merit requirement before applying.

Examples from the verified university information include: B.Tech applicants need the relevant Class 12 subjects and must meet the university's minimum percentage requirements through the applicable GUEE or JEE Main route; MBA applicants need a bachelor's degree and an accepted entrance score; PhD applicants generally need a relevant master's degree and PET or an accepted national-level score. Exact criteria should be confirmed from the current official programme information.
